rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for rejecting a request or demand.

example.english: I had to repel his request for a pay rise.
example.traditional: 我唯有拒絕佢加人工嘅要求。
example.jyutping: ngo5 wai4 jau5 keoi5 zyut6 keoi5 gaa1 jan4 gung1 ge3 jiu1 kau4

rows.note: Use this when a person, thing, or behaviour makes someone dislike it or feel disgusted.

example.english: That person's expression is so disgusting, it could repel anyone.
example.traditional: 佢嗰副嘴臉真係令人反感，見親都想避開佢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 go2 fu3 zeoi2 lim5 zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 faan2 gam2 gin3 can1 dou1 soeng2 bei6 hoi1 keoi5

rows.note: Use this for driving back an attack, attacker, advancing force, or other threatening influence; it is more common in formal or written descriptions.

example.english: The police use water cannons to repel those attacking the cordon.
example.traditional: 警方以水炮擊退衝擊防線嘅人。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 ji5 seoi2 paau3 gik1 teoi3 cung1 gik1 fong4 sin3 ge3 jan4
